analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($1.39) vs SMA5($1.44)/SMA20($1.49)/SMA50($1.43): below short/mid-term trends.
· Position vs SMA100($1.26)/SMA200($1.28): maintaining strength above long-term trends.
· 52-week position (22.0%): near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (59.0→43.3): exiting oversold, moving into neutral territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0057→-0.0196): worsening in negative territory, signaling weak convergence.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (Lower Band $1.39): confirming lower band support, band width expanding at 13.78%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($1.38): based on EMA50 and Bollinger lower band.
· Swing Resistance ($1.47): based on SMA5 and Pivot PP, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Neither Higher Low nor Lower High met, indicating sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.50x): surge above 5-day average, increasing confidence in price action.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, consolidating between $1.38 support and $1.47 resistance, maintaining wait-and-see conditions.
